LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Enabled_Tooltip: Whether highstorms occur. When disabled, no highstorms will be scheduled.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Pushing_Tooltip: Storms push items and pawns that are caught outside in the open
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Damage_Tooltip: Turn off if you don't want all your wildlife to die, and your visitors to hate you
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_MinInterval_Toolti: Minimum number of days between highstorms.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_MaxInterval_Toolti: Maximum number of days between highstorms.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_EnableWeeping_Tool: If enabled, highstorms pause for the last 14 days of each year.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Duration_Tooltip: Base duration of each highstorm in ticks. 2500 ticks per in-game hour. Default is 20000 (8 hours).
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_AverageTicks_Label: Average Spren Spawn Minimum Tick Interval:
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_AverageTicks_Toolt: What is the average number of ticks that must pass between True Spren spawns (60ticks / second)
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MinimumTicks_Label: True Spren Spawn Minimum Tick Interval:
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MinimumTicks_Toolt: What is the minimum number of ticks that must pass between True Spren spawns (60ticks / second)
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MaximumTicks_Label: True Spren Spawn Maximum Tick Interval:
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MaximumTicks_Toolt: What is the maximum number of ticks that must pass between True Spren spawns (60ticks / second)
LanguageData.CR_Settings_LesserSpren_Enabled_Tooltip: Should the game render the lesser spren particles? If this is disabled, spren will still be capturable, you just won't be able to see them
LanguageData.CR_Settings_LesserSpren_MaximumZoom_Tool: How far out will the game stop rendering lesser spren particles? Note, they will still spawn, you just wont be able to see them
LanguageData.CR_Settings_IdealProgression_Difficulty_: Multiplier for Ideal progression requirements. Lower values make advancement easier, higher values make it harder. (0.5x - 2.0x)
LanguageData.CR_Settings_IdealProgression_ShowRequire: Display the specific requirements a Radiant must meet to speak their next Ideal
